label: PSK with known symbols
about: Supply the actual symbol indices, clock and pulse shape. Natural phase mapping is explicit; bit/Gray mapping is not inferred. Finite RRC comparisons require all neighboring pulse support. Manual alignment and a small time-domain residual do not establish synchronization, equalization or symbol EVM.
symbols.help: Up to 256 decimal indices separated by spaces or commas; each k is in 0…M−1 and maps to exp(j·2π·k/M). Example for QPSK: 0 1 3 2. These are known indices, not decoded bits.
issue.parameter: Enter a value within the allowed range for this complete configuration.
issue.unknown: This model does not declare the supplied parameter.
issue.nyquist: The carrier or nominal RRC design band exceeds the input Nyquist interval. Truncation does not prove occupied bandwidth.
issue.symbols: Supply 1–256 indices in 0…M−1, using at most 4096 bytes of text.
issue.support: The finite known sequence does not cover the full alignment search and, for RRC, every neighboring pulse. Supply more known symbols or reduce the selected range/alignment.
